tidbit: Did you know… this hour's top stories come from five different outlets.
transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
California doctors and nurses must perform medicine under new state law, banning artificial intelligence from independently prescribing or ordering medical tests. Confirmed by East Bay Times.
Microsoft and Anthropic are involved in invoice discussions over a startup's $17,600 Claude bill. Reported by The Register.
China boosts employment through artificial intelligence policies and new jobs, with over 200 occupational standards planned by 2030. Confirmed by RTHK News: Beijing announces jobs initiative amid artificial intelligence impact.
OpenAI makes progress in preventing artificial intelligence driven ChatGPT delusions. Reported by WSJ.
Apate uses 350k artificial intelligence bots to stop scammers and collect fraud data, getting really good at messing with cybercriminals. Confirmed by Wired.
Free every hour.
